bugs.notes: Split production.json paste UX: while receiving split bubbles, show a 'Receiving .json file...' style indicator (never a partial/'part one' message); resolve cleanly to success once fully assembled. Reported a third time (prior bug-27/bug-38 'done' statuses NOT trusted) — re-investigate from current code.

bugs.title: Zero-setup cloning — bot auto-creates the GitHub repo via API from the user's PAT
bugs.notes: Remove requirement that the user manually create a GitHub repo before cloning. New flow: user provides GitHub PAT + optional repo name (or bot auto-names); bot creates the repo via GitHub API using the PAT, then proceeds with clone setup against it. Must verify PAT scope allows repo creation; note clearly if not.

bugs.title: News-push feature to clones, with optional recurring interval (min 6h)
bugs.notes: Main account can push a 'news' message to all connected clone deployments. One-off push + optional recurring push on a set interval (minimum 6 hours). Settings UI/flow at implementer's judgment; scheduling likely via scheduled GitHub Actions workflow or Cloudflare Worker cron, matching existing scheduled-behavior architecture (e.g. Zernio smart schedule).

bugs.title: Remove duplicate Zernio settings from completed-task view; verify publishing end-to-end
bugs.notes: Zernio publishing settings appear both in main Settings and on a completed Stage B task view — remove from the completed-task view entirely; keep only in main Settings. Also re-verify automatic Zernio publishing actually works end-to-end when enabled (prior bug-24 fix not trusted — confirm against current behavior).

bugs.title: Series task flow dead-ends after a part completes — missing next-part and copy-prompt actions, no way to revisit completed parts
bugs.notes: After a series-mode part finishes (Stage B complete), task view lacks: (1) action to proceed to the next part, (2) the copy-prompt button (exists for non-series tasks per prior bug-09/bug-10 — confirm whether simply missing from series-complete view), (3) a way to later view/access previously completed series parts (e.g. from /done or a dedicated series view) for re-download/repost.

bugs.title: Series tasks must not expire until the entire series is complete
bugs.notes: Current 12h task expiry (per prior bug-03/bug-37) appears to apply per-part even in series mode. For series-mode tasks, no part of an incomplete series may be cleaned up/expired until every part reaches a completed/terminal state. Must not break general (non-series) expiry/cleanup behavior.

bugs.title: Remove the series-mode toggle from the /new task-creation flow
bugs.notes: Series mode is controlled as a default/setting in main Settings (already exists there), not a per-task choice. Remove the series toggle/option from the /new wizard entirely; task creation follows the current Settings value without asking per task.
